newsitem.title: CHINA: China's capital uses $830 mln foreign funds in Q1.
newsitem.headline: China's capital uses $830 mln foreign funds in Q1.

text.p: China's capital Beijing used $830 million in foreign funds in the first three months of this year, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
Of that amount, $589 million was direct investment, Xinhua quoted the local foreign trade commission as saying.
About 51 percent of foreign investment in the three months went to the service sector, up from 39 percent in the year-ago period, it said.
Urban infrastructure, technological upgrading, tourism and housing were being given priority for overseas investment, it said without elaborating.
The city had more than 12,000 foreign-funded firms with a total investment of $19.89 billion, it said but gave no further details.
